items.proposed: ["bevacizumab", "pd-l1 t-hank nk cell therapy", "tumour treating fields (device)"]
items.reason: Same content; only labels differ (PD-L1 t-haNK is an NK cell therapy, TTFields a device).

Phase 2B Arm A ("N-803, 1 mg SC Bevacizumab, 10 mg/kg IV ... TTFields") contains the candidate N-803, so it is not a standard-of-care or placebo control; it only controls for the cell therapy (an excluded intervention) in Arm B.

note: R8 examples (standard of care or placebo) support 'no'; 'yes' is arguable if XL counts any within-trial comparator arm as a control.
